# P1 Write Error Cases — type validation errors

-- unknown-type.md --
---
type: nonexistent
title: Test
---
Content
-- unknown-type.md --

-- no-type.md --
---
title: No Type
---
Content
-- no-type.md --

-- no-title.md --
---
type: note
---
Content
-- no-title.md --

-- empty-fm.md --
---
---
Content
-- empty-fm.md --

-- no-fm.md --
Just some content without frontmatter
-- no-fm.md --

# Setup: initialize a KB
exec akb init test-kb
cd test-kb

# --- Unknown type: type not in templates ---
! exec akb write unknown-type.md <../unknown-type.md
stderr 'unknown type'

# --- Missing type field entirely ---
! exec akb write no-type.md <../no-type.md
stderr 'missing required field .type.'

# --- Missing title field ---
! exec akb write no-title.md <../no-title.md
stderr 'missing required field .title.'

# --- Empty frontmatter ---
! exec akb write empty-fm.md <../empty-fm.md
stderr 'empty frontmatter'

# --- No frontmatter at all ---
! exec akb write no-fm.md <../no-fm.md
stderr 'no frontmatter found'

# --- Stdin required (no pipe) ---
! exec akb write no-stdin.md
stderr 'input required'
